view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large, well-lit warehouse interior with high ceilings and concrete floors. Multiple forklifts and pallet jacks are parked or in use near tall metal racks filled with stacked boxes. Yellow safety bollards line walkways. A person in red is visible in the distance. The space appears organized and operational.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Orange and black forklift with 'STILL' branding on front, parked on left side near rack labeled '6'. It has a raised mast and is stationary. Partially occluded by adjacent equipment. Supported by ground contact. No visible attachments beyond standard forklift components.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Another orange and black forklift, similar to ID 1, parked further down the aisle to the left. Its rear is partially visible. Appears stationary. Supported by ground contact. No visible attachments beyond standard forklift components.

objects.label: pallet jack
objects.observation: Metallic pallet jack with a large beige tarp covering its load, positioned centrally near rack labeled '7'. Wheels are visible. Supported by ground contact. No visible attachments beyond standard pallet jack components.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: Tall, black metal shelving unit extending from ceiling to floor, labeled '6' and '7'. Loaded with cardboard boxes. Located along right side of aisle. Supported by structural beams. Contacts floor at base. No visible attachments beyond standard rack construction.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Individual wearing red clothing walking in the distant background, near the far end of the aisle. Partially occluded by racks. No visible attachments. Supported by ground contact. No visible equipment or tools.

objects.label: yellow safety bollard
objects.observation: Yellow cylindrical bollard with black base, located on right side near foreground. Mounted on ground. Supports itself. No visible attachments beyond ground contact. Part of safety barrier system.

objects.label: cardboard box
objects.observation: Stacked cardboard boxes on pallet near rack '7', partially obscured by forklift. Brown color, standard shipping box shape. Supported by pallet. Contacts ground via pallet. No visible attachments beyond standard packaging.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s4-32109", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
